title: Openship App definition
description: An Openship App catalog entry — the JSON that turns a set of containers into a one-click install, with generated secrets, a curated settings form, and a connection card. Full reference: https://openship.io/docs/reference/app-catalog

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. Must match the filename and be globally unique.

name.description: Display name shown in the catalog.

description.description: One-line summary shown on the catalog card.

kind.description: template instantiates the declared services; flow points at a bespoke built-in wizard.

logo.description: A simpleicons slug, or an id mapped to a vendored SVG in the dashboard.

tags.description: Free-form keywords used for catalog search.

framework.description: Stack slug for the created project. Usually "docker-compose" for template apps.

flowHref.description: For kind:"flow" — internal route of the bespoke wizard. Must start with "/".

services.description: The containers to run. Required in practice for template apps.

configFields.description: Machine-generated or derived env only — never rendered as a form input. For values the user types, use a setting with installStep:true.

settings.description: The curated settings form. A field with installStep:true is also collected in the install wizard.

prepare.description: Commands run inside a service container after start. Must be re-run safe.

endpoints.description: How the install wizard offers to expose each port. Omit for one http endpoint per exposed service.

files.description: Generated config files bind-mounted into a container at deploy. Self-hosted and desktop only.

provides.description: Connectable bundles this app advertises to other projects.

requires.description: Connections this app needs from another project in the same organization.

management.description: Override how the installed app is managed. Omit to derive (schema when settings exist, else raw project tabs).

href.description: Internal route of the bespoke management surface.

available.description: false or omitted → shown dimmed as "coming soon" and not installable (enforced server-side too).

verified.description: Curated-catalog marker. Forced by the server on custom uploads — authoring it has no effect.

schemaVersion.description: JSON shape revision. Defaults to 1. Bump only on a genuinely breaking shape change.

minEngine.description: Minimum Openship version required to install this app. Set it to the release that introduced whatever capability the definition uses.

localized.description: A plain string, or an inline per-locale map such as { "en": "…", "ar": "…" }.

name.description: Service name, and its hostname on the project network. Other services reach it at this exact name.

image.description: Container image. Pin a version — unpinned tags are rejected in review.

exposedPort.description: The container port that receives the public route.

exposed.description: Marks this service as the one that gets a public route.

routes.description: For a service needing more than one public port.

slugSuffix.description: Distinguishes the extra hostname for this port.

environment.description: Non-secret env defaults. Supports {{publicUrl:service}} and {{config:KEY}} placeholders.

secretEnv.description: Env keys on this service that are secrets — forced encrypted and never written as plaintext, whether the value comes from environment or a configField.

volumes.description: Compose-style volumes. Named volumes are project-scoped.

dependsOn.description: Other service names this one starts after.

healthcheck.description: Container healthcheck. disable:true turns off an image baked-in check.

key.description: Env key this value writes to.

service.description: Service whose env receives it. Must name a declared service.

default.description: Default value when nothing is generated.

generate.description: secret = a random value the operator never types. jwt = a signed key.

generateGroup.description: Fields sharing a group receive the SAME generated value — how a database password matches on both sides.

jwtSecretGroup.description: For generate:"jwt" — the generateGroup holding the signing secret. Must match a declared generateGroup.

jwtRole.description: Role claim baked into the generated JWT.

secret.description: Store encrypted and mask on display.

key.description: Env key this field writes to.

service.description: Service whose env it writes to. Must name a declared service.

options.description: Choices for select, radio, and multiselect.

separator.description: For multiselect — how chosen values are joined into the env value.

secret.description: Store encrypted and mask on display.

trueValue.description: For type:"boolean" — env value written when on, e.g. "1" or "yes".

falseValue.description: For type:"boolean" — env value written when off.

requiresRedeploy.description: Changing this field needs a redeploy to take effect; the UI says so.

installStep.description: Also collect this field in the install wizard — this is the human-input surface.

required.description: Gate install or save on a value being present.

showIf.description: Conditional visibility. equals or truthy only — no expressions.

service.description: Service whose container runs the command. Must name a declared service.

command.description: Command to run inside the container.

capturePattern.description: Regex to extract the value out of noisier output.

persistAs.description: Persist the captured value as this env key.

once.description: Run on first install only, never on later deploys.

phase.description: When it runs. Defaults to post-start. NOTE: pre-deploy is reserved and not yet run by the engine.

mustSucceed.description: Fail the deploy if the step errors. Default false = advisory.

readiness.description: For phase:"post-ready" — poll test via sh -c every interval ms up to retries before running.

icon.description: Icon id for the stepper row.

defaultMode.description: Which form of the values is shown first.

firstLogin.description: Static default credentials the app ships with, e.g. Grafana admin/admin. Fixed values, not resolved from a running service.

outputSource.description: env:<service>:<KEY>, publicUrl:<service>[:<port>], or template:… — anything else fails validation.

secret.description: Mask the value with a reveal action.

envKey.description: Env key to prefill when handing this value to another project.

service.description: Source service alias — authoritative for internal-mode host rewriting. Set it when a template: source cannot carry the service.

recommended.description: Highlight this output in the "Use in a project" handover.

variants.description: Labeled alternative forms of the same value, e.g. a public versus an internal-network URL. Rendered as a switch.

width.description: half pairs two short outputs on one line, e.g. user and password.

kind.description: url adds an open-in-new-tab action. Honored only when the resolved value is http(s).

service.description: Service this port belongs to. Must name a declared service.

label.description: How the wizard names this endpoint.

kind.description: http is domain-routable; tcp is a raw port such as a database, with no domain.

required.description: The user must choose an exposure for it.

service.description: Service to mount into. Must name a declared service.

outputRefs.description: Ids of connection.outputs to include. Each must reference a real output.

envKey.description: Env key the chosen connection is written to.

category.description: Restrict candidate sources to this category.

mode.description: Which form of the source value to wire in.
